title: Compare two small groups the lab's way
when: comparing a score between two groups of a small study in data.csv before writing up the result
request: Compare the scores of groups A and B in data.csv (a small fictitious study; the protocol is in PROTOCOL.md). Write analysis.json with: raw ({"file", "sha256"}), exclusions ({"rule", "excluded" (list of participant ids)}), n ({"A", "B"}), test (the test's name), statistic, effect_size ({"name", "value"}), medians ({"A", "B"}), iqr ({"A": [q1, q3], "B": [q1, q3]}) and seed, and RESULTS.md, a short write-up of the result for the lab.
